QuestInfo.name: [Gingerbread] Bringing the Freshness
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Gingerbread Man, since you already promised him.
QuestInfo.1: Hold onto a #i3994801##bHalf-baked Gingerbread Cookie#k and stay online for 30 minutes to help it reach its ultimate deliciousness. When the cookie is all baked, talk to the Gingerbread Man.
QuestInfo.2: You made a friend for Gingerbread Man and received a gift. He says you can get a  #i5000299##bGingerbread Man#k if you make him 1 friend a day for 10 days! At least you'll smell super good!

0.0: You're here to bake my doughy little friends, right? Are you ready?!

yes.0: Awesome! Just hold onto this Half-baked Gingerbread Cookie and #bstay online for 30 minutes#k... The warmth from your sweet little body will turn it into a fully-baked Gingerbread Cookie. Just #rdon't log out, or the cookie will crumble to pieces#k!
yes.1: How does the cookie bake so well? You just need to give it all your love! Anyway come to me when the cookie is ready!

no.0: Whaaat? Then why did you talk to me?

default.0: Whaa? It's not ready yet! Patience, my fleshy friend, patience.
